changesMade: Wordmark (235:422) now scales with the headline instead of being hard-locked at 157x28. Mechanism: the tag was sized `h-7 w-[157px]` at every width while `--text-display-xl` is clamp(2.75rem, 7.5vw, 6.75rem), so as the headline dropped to ~58px (768) and 44px (390) the wordmark kept its desktop size and read as a second headline (measured 0.38 and 0.54 of the longest headline line against the 0.21 the 1440 frame sets). The Title frame now carries `font-size: var(--text-display-xl)` so the wordmark can be measured in em of the headline: new named constant `--hero-wordmark-ratio: 1.4537` (= 157/108, the ratio Figma draws) gives width `calc(var(--hero-wordmark-ratio) * 1em)` with `height: auto`, i.e. exactly 157px at 1440, ~84px at 768, ~64px at 390. Only one axis is constrained; the ratio comes from the asset's intrinsic 157x28.

Lead block (181:502) got a feathered legibility wash below 992px only. Mechanism: at 1440 the 48% quiet run sits in the right gutter over pale open sky, but below the desktop frame the column moves under the title (spec Section 1, Responsive) and the masts reach into that band, dropping the drawn 48% to ~2.5:1 over the bright mast panels - two previous iterations tried to solve this by moving the block (down onto the hull, then back up) and neither position exists at these widths. The vessel plate cannot be re-anchored to help either: the raster is 1.418:1 against a portrait stage, so `object-fit: cover` crops horizontally only and `object-position` has no vertical effect below lg. Instead of altering the drawn colour token, `.lead::before` paints a radial wash of the surface colour (`rgb(var(--white-rgb) / 0.68)` fading to 0 at 76%) inset by `--space-xlg` so it feathers to nothing inside its own bleed - no panel edge. Strictly gated off at >=992px, so the drawn desktop frame is untouched.

Token hygiene on the two drawn hero offsets: `lg:mt-37` -> `lg:mt-[var(--space-6xl)]` (148px, spec 'title top 148px') and `lg:mt-24` -> `lg:mt-[var(--space-4xl)]` (96px, spec 'title block -> lead top 96px'). Same computed values - both are literal spec numbers on the 4px base unit and already have named tokens in globals.css - but they now reference the tokens rather than restating the numbers.
summary: Made the wordmark proportional to the clamped display type (1.4537em, the 157/108 ratio Figma draws) so it stops reading as a second headline at tablet/mobile, and gave the lead a feathered surface-colour wash below 992px so its 48% quiet run clears the bright mast panels; the hero-imagery CRITICAL is an asset-export problem (Figma 247:655 has two image fills and the build carries the lower one) that I could not act on because binary assets are off-limits this pass, and the Exposure/Matter size-adjust fallbacks live in the shared globals.css.
